recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The current authoritative Procedure definition and notes convey the requested supplies-used capability; extra prose would be redundant and could drift from the element definition.
issue_request: Published Patient Care change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking how to represent supplies used during a procedure. The resolution requested an optional repeating used element supporting codeable concepts and references to Device, Medication, or Substance, plus device wording that distinguishes supplies from focal implanted/removed devices.
initial_application: SVN r4981, imported as git commit f734eb20e9cea5803c519475780be919724f148f, added Procedure.used to the then-current Procedure spreadsheet as 0..* Reference(Device|Medication|Substance) with item-used wording. Later Procedure.used changes refined the element rather than removing the seed intent.
additional_context: FHIR-9821 later completed the code-or-reference part by splitting Procedure.used into usedCode and usedReference. R5/R6 source now expresses that same design as Procedure.used CodeableReference, with fhir.ini mapping usedCode and usedReference to Procedure.used. FHIR-22800 added BiologicallyDerivedProduct as another material target, FHIR-31539 confirms the R5 CodeableReference representation, and FHIR-34525 clarified the focal-device comment. Quoted community searches found no FHIR-3715-specific conflict.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. source/fhir.ini actively includes Procedure, and source/procedure/structuredefinition-Procedure.xml defines Procedure.used as 0..* CodeableReference(Device|Medication|Substance|BiologicallyDerivedProduct) with an item-used definition and code binding. source/procedure/procedure-notes.xml explains incidental devices such as scalpels, gauze, and endoscopes versus devices handled by Procedure.focalDevice.manipulated.
